reqBaseAnnouncement.remarks:
Pursuant to section 7.8 of the Listing Rules of Colombo Stock Exchange, we write to inform that the below mentioned persons are Directors of Maharaja Foods PLC ("MFPE") and GTV Global Holdings Pvt Ltd by which the shares of Maharaja Foods PLC were sold as per the details provided in the table given below:

Mr. Guganathan Vijayananth - Chairman/Executive Director of MFPE & Executive Director of GTV Global Holdings

Mr. Guganathan Vithyanath - Managing Director/Executive Director of MFPE & Executive Director of GTV Global Holdings

Mrs. Thavamalar Guganathan - Executive/ Non-Independent Director of MFPE & Executive Director of GTV Global Holdings

Mr. Guganathan Gohulnath - Non-Executive/Non-Independent Director of MFPE & Executive Director of GTV Global Holdings
